description: The best time to visit Majorda beach is in the month of November to February (no rains). The distance to the beach from Panaji is 28 km. The best way to get to Majorda is by renting a bike, car or even a taxi. Here you will find many beach shacks lined up and restaurants with sun beds which can give you a whole different experience of being in Goa. To do list: -Boat rides: Sail around the blue sea and experience life in the middle of the sea. Watch the birds sit on the calm water. And if you are lucky enough, you might get to watch the mystical dolphins. -Ancestral Goa: One place you must visit is the ancestral Goa museum which is only 10 km away from the beach. It is an open air museum which is also a restaurant. So you can dine as well as look around. -Monte Hill Chapel: This is a 16th century chapel which is not commonly known by the tourists. But it’s a beautiful place you must visit if you are around Majorda. Water sports: One of the best for activities. Try out some thrilling sports like paragliding, parasailing, banana ride and so on. Shopping: There is a small market where you will find spices, clothes and accessories. There are many bakeries as well. Nightlife: Pubs, clubs are everywhere around Majorda. Night time is the best here since there is loud music and you will find a lot of people dancing. Not to miss out the sunrise and sunset as this beach is known to have a beautiful sunrise and sunset view! How To Reach Majorda Beach By Air Goa International Airport is the primary airport serving the city if you intend to fly there to visit Majorda Beach Location. Just this airport is used for arrivals and departures of both domestic and international planes. There are about 29 kilometers between the Goa Airport and Majorda Beach. To get to Majorda Beach, you can take a taxi, cab, or auto-rickshaw from the airport. How To Reach Majorda Beach By Road The Majorda Beach is roughly 30 kilometers from the city center. As a result, getting to the beach location from anywhere in Goa is pretty simple. In addition, there are numerous interstate bus routes operating out of Mumbai, Pune, and Delhi. Use the national highway if you want to drive yourself or take a taxi to Majorda Beach. How To Reach Majorda Beach By Rail Rail is yet another convenient way to get to Majorda Beach South Goa. Majorda and Cansaulim station are the two closest railway stations to Majorda Beach (each is 2.4 km away) (5.3 km). To get to Majorda Beach quickly, choose one of the taxis or auto-rickshaws waiting outside the train station. How To Reach Majorda Beach From Panaji Majorda Beach is quite far from the Panaji city region because it is situated in South Goa. The distance from Panaji to Majorda Beach is approximately 30.4 kilometers. Depending on the method of transportation you select, it will take 40 to 50 minutes to travel the distance. One of the simplest ways to go this distance is via bus, which will only cost you about INR 30–40 from the Panaji bus terminal. To get to Majorda Beach Goa directly from Panaji, you can also take a taxi.

headers.content:
Majorda Beach occasionally has crowds. Hence, if you don't want to spend money at the beach, it is preferable to carry less cash.
If you're driving your own car, arrive to the seashore and depart early because the parking lot is very busy.
Be careful to carry a list of all your emergency contacts. When it becomes late, this will assist you in ensuring your safety.
Plan the remaining activities properly because there is heavy traffic on the route leading to Majorda Beach on weekends.
Bring your backpack and all of your necessities, including your water bottle, sunglasses, and sunscreen.
